title: Heart Rate Variability Prediction of Stimulant-Induced Creativity Gains in Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder.
authors: Appling C, Nuraini N, Hart E, Wang D, Tosh A, Beversdorf D, Ferguson B.
